description: Find installed modules or plugins by name or description (ansible-doc -l), ranked exact name, prefix, token, then description match. Pass query, collection, or both.

collection.description: Limit to one collection, e.g. ansible.posix

dir.description: Ansible project directory. Default: ANSIBLE_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

query.description: Case-insensitive name or description text, e.g. 'firewall'

name: ansible_module_search
title: Search installed plugins
